block_bits: z bit k is the outcome of the block's position k, position k on blocks[block][k]

preregistered.readout: per-qubit e01 from readout-0 and e10 from readout-1, the mean of the batch-00 and batch-03 brackets; a bracket difference above 0.02 on a block qubit is reported

q13.context: q13's e10 by the true state of (q10, q11): (0,0) readout-q13, (1,0) readout-q13-q10, (0,1) readout-q13-q11, (1,1) readout-1; q13's e01 from readout-0; the block response is the 16 x 16 product of the other qubits' channels with that conditional channel
q13.attribution: delta_drive = e10(readout-q13-xx) - e10(readout-q13) and delta_q10, delta_q11 = e10(readout-q13-qN) - e10(readout-q13); a delta is established at |delta| >= delta_min and |z| >= z_decision; drive alone, state alone, both or neither

preregistered.class_order: K_high > K_low on each block at z >= z_decision in every job; a reversal refutes the emitted circuits
preregistered.interaction: I = ln V(high, X) - ln V(high, Y) - ln V(low, X) + ln V(low, Y), V = (K - 1/16) / (K_ideal - 1/16), each job's block pooled over its replicates; |I| >= z_decision SE establishes a class-by-block interaction, which a per-block multiplicative fidelity excludes
preregistered.shape: per job and block, lambda fitted by maximum likelihood to raw counts N R (lambda P + (1 - lambda) / 16); a G statistic with 14 degrees of freedom at log10 p <= shape_log10_p rejects the depolarizing shape, the signature of a coherent error
preregistered.replicates: TVD between the batch-01 and batch-02 copies of each block; above scatter_allowance plus z_decision SE is reported as batch scatter
preregistered.forbidden: corrected weight outside the ideal support, per job and block

prediction.basis: global depolarizing with retention 0.965 per CZ; informational, no decision rests on it; rho above 1 in the ladder already excludes global depolarizing as the whole channel
